name: Local Legend
controllingIdea: Every neighborhood has stories that transform addresses into destinations.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A local business, person, place, or tradition introduced
narrativeArc.risingAction: History, character, and community role revealed
narrativeArc.crisis: Why this matters to residents - the deeper meaning
narrativeArc.climax: The experience of engaging with it

questions.question: What local spot, person, or tradition are you featuring?
questions.placeholder: Mario's Bakery has been on Main Street for 40 years...

questions.question: What's the story or history behind it?
questions.placeholder: Mario came from Italy in 1984 and started with a single bread recipe...

questions.question: What do locals love about it that visitors might miss?
questions.placeholder: Everyone knows about the croissants, but the real secret is the Saturday morning focaccia...

questions.question: What makes this meaningful to the community?
questions.placeholder: It's where everyone goes after Little League games. Kids grow up here...

questions.question: What would you tell someone visiting for the first time?
questions.placeholder: Go on a Saturday morning, get the focaccia, and sit on the patio...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a community-building piece. Position the agent as a true local who knows the neighborhood beyond listings. It's about lifestyle and belonging.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Enthusiastic local guide sharing insider knowledge. Warm, authentic, not promotional. Let the love for the area show.

usageHints: Great for positioning as a true local expert
Visit and photograph yourself - authenticity matters
Tag the local business when posting

exampleScenarios.title: The 40-Year-Old Bakery
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Mario's Bakery has been on the corner of Main and 5th for 40 years. Mario came from Naples and still uses his grandmother's recipes. The Saturday focaccia sells out by 9am. Every kid in this neighborhood has celebrated a birthday with his cakes.

expectedOutput.hook: 40 years. One corner. Every birthday cake you remember.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: The focaccia sells out by 9am. Set your alarm.
